Name: Shay - New NPC
Author: JamesClawk
Description:
[center][color=#cc0000][size=5][b]This version is not currently being updated. For a more up to date version, you can find silvermoonchan's version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45612]HERE[/url].[/b][/size][/color]

TW:
[spoiler]Like Shane's vanilla story, Shay's story will have references to alcohol and will involve depression. Note, however, that she is her own character and exploration of these themes will differ from Shane's story.[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]Note: Shay is an unlockable NPC. To unlock her:[/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]You must first see Shane's 6-Heart event, then head to Marnie's Ranch at a specific time. If you'd like more details, see guide.txt in the mod.[/size][/spoiler]
[/center]
Shay is Shane's twin sister. The two haven't seen each other in a while, but after hearing about what Shane's been going through, she hops on a bus headed to Pelican Town.

[size=3][b]Features
[/b][/size]Shay currently has:
- A 2-part Introduction Event
- 2 Heart Events
- A Simple Schedule
- Some Basic Dialogue

She doesn't have a ton of content right now, but I have plenty planned for future updates. Speaking of...
[size=3][b]Future Plans
[/b][/size] - More events, a more involved schedule following her 6-heart event, and more dialogue.
 - Shay dating unlock
 - Shay marriage unlock (Yes, you will need to do more than date her and reach 10 hearts)
 - Some additional events and changes for Shane
 - Shay goes to festivals
...and more!

[size=2]TrentXV's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Boarding House and Bus Stop Extension[/url]﻿
